subject: A material swatch, not an object or scene: an orthographic full-frame photogrammetry-quality cross-polarized albedo scan of one single ancient rough-hewn sweet chestnut timber surface, previously stripped of its bark. Grain runs vertically along the entire tall frame. Weather-beaten chestnut brown growth fibers, silver-grey raised wood, long fine dark splits, one small crooked knot, a couple of ridges of remaining darker bark and modest lichen freckles. The wood is very old, fibrous and subtly damp, not glossy or golden pine. An irregular hand-split post in an old European forest. Neutral diffuse soft shadowless illumination, uniform midtone, true stained wood colors, crisp small-scale relief readable from color but no cast or directional shadows. Fill every pixel edge to edge with one wood surface, no background, no ground, no metal, no holes, no letters, no border, no planks or straight seams, no perspective or lighting effects. This will be wrapped on a separate 3D mesh in a game engine.
